hints.title: Parity of n
hints.text: Consider whether the given length n is odd or even.

hints.title: Single Character for Odd
hints.text: If n is odd, repeating a single letter n times gives an odd frequency.

hints.title: Split for Even
hints.text: If n is even, repeating a character n - 1 times and appending one different character leaves both counts odd.
